recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片高倍率可見兩顆巨大的巨核細胞相鄰，細胞核多葉且重疊、細胞質豐富帶細小粉紅顆粒，其中一顆細胞質內含一顆小細胞（emperipolesis）；在同一視野出現多顆成熟巨核細胞，支持巨核細胞增生，但真正增生仍需低倍率計數評估。
features: Two very large mature megakaryocytes side by side
Multilobated, overlapping nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Abundant pale blue-grey cytoplasm with fine pink-purple granules
A small cell engulfed within megakaryocyte cytoplasm (emperipolesis)
Adjacent clump of small dark cells and surrounding fat vacuoles
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows two large, mature megakaryocytes lying adjacent to each other, with multilobated overlapping nuclei and abundant finely granular cytoplasm. A small hematopoietic cell is present within the cytoplasm of one megakaryocyte, consistent with emperipolesis. The megakaryocytes lack obvious hypolobation, micro-forms or bizarre hyperchromatic nuclei in this field. Although two megakaryocytes in a single high-power field suggest increased numbers, megakaryocytic hyperplasia should be assessed by low-power evaluation of particles or the core biopsy; findings are compatible with megakaryocytic hyperplasia.

ddx.vs: MPN megakaryocytes are often enlarged, hyperlobated (staghorn) or form tight clusters on biopsy, and require JAK2/CALR/MPL testing and clinical correlation.

ddx.dx: Reactive megakaryocytic hyperplasia (ITP, blood loss, inflammation)
ddx.vs: Reactive megakaryocytes are normal-appearing and dispersed, without clustering or atypia, and there is a clinical cause for increased platelet turnover.
MDS megakaryocytes are small, hypolobated or have separated round nuclei, which are not seen here.
Osteoclasts have multiple separate uniform round nuclei rather than a single multilobated nucleus.
